description: NHFLOW hydrostatic semi-implicit, 3 km x 3 km basin 10 m deep: clamped level edges on x- and y+ with one background given at 3 points (B 510 mode 4): the tide varies along the edges (0.10 m at the SW corner, 0.30 m / 30 deg at the NW corner, 0.20 m / 60 deg at the NE corner, linear in between). The edge gauges follow the interpolated level.
covers: B 510 mode 4: projection on the polyline (two segments, both edges), clamped level edges x- and y+ with SI
